title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our AI team. You will design, build, and deploy ML models that power our core product. You'll work closely with data engineers and product teams to ship production-grade solutions.
responsibilities: Design and implement ML pipelines from data ingestion to model deployment
Train, evaluate, and optimize deep learning models for computer vision and NLP tasks
Build and maintain scalable inference services
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into ML solutions
Monitor model performance in production and iterate based on metrics
nice_to_have: Familiarity with ONNX, TensorRT, or model optimization
Kubernetes or cloud ML platforms (AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI)
interview_focus: Technical depth in ML fundamentals and practical application
Ability to take a project from research to production
